postcards.subject: Idyll & Imaginings
postcards.message:
Hey!
I hope you're having fun in London. I wonder what about all the things you're seeing and trying. I hope it's not exhausting you too much, though.
I hope the weather is moody in the best way, that you got to try some authentic fish & chips, and that British people are real. Say hello to the Queen if you see her!

postcards.subject: Gold, Glum
postcards.message:
Hello!
I had pancakes at Glen's for breakfast today. They were not very good. Would not recommend — bad maple syrup and dense pancakes. Wondering if you've had some good British food yet (tea and bottles of water don't count). I want to ask you so many things, but I guess I'm putting them here for now...
 Strange to miss you more that you're in London, when the cadence of our communication hasn't changed much, but I do.
Have a good day, I know you'll do well.

postcards.subject: Rainy Rumination
postcards.message:
Hello!
It's raining here and Hilbert is settling in for a nap as I write this. I hope Haju is doing okay too. I wonder if it's been raining in London as well. Time-zones make things confusing. I hope you're not suffering from jet-lag too much.

postcards.subject: Sofie's Sharaarat
postcards.message:
Hey
Sofie and Hilbert are slowly warming up to each other, as you can see.
I'm keeping myself busy. Spent today cooking (made a salami sandwich), studying physics (still in that textbook), thinking about you (hope you have a bright day), painting (a few projects). Sending warmth...

postcards.subject: Chores and Bores
postcards.message:
Hello,
 Beautiful sunset today. I'm guessing this may be the first card you see, as I sent you the link today. I've started reading Stone Mattress and rearranged my books, been working on a paper you might find interesting. Been attending the IEEE Quantum Week conference this week. and gotta take Hilbert to the vet today too. 
Hope you're having a good week.
